decision_consumer: decide whether Plan lifecycle identity and ownership checks add tested fail-closed behavior beyond the Qwen3-Next asynchronous performance result
objective: Execute one real-adapter, real-GPU no-fault control and nine deterministic fault cells at 512+8 with the cache disabled, preserving every negative and accepting the integrated lifecycle claim only if every declared transition behaves as predicted.
claim_boundary: One RTX 3090, one Qwen3-Next Q4_K_M artifact, one 512-token truncation of the frozen natural prompt, eight greedy fixed-horizon outputs, zero cache, one binary, and the exact deterministic hooks below. This tests named transitions; it does not prove race freedom, concurrency safety, serving isolation, or general fault tolerance.

workload.sampling: greedy with every EOG token masked to negative infinity for exactly eight outputs

faults.none: ordinary eight-window asynchronous control; eight outputs and all ledgers must close
faults.short_read: first graph-demanded source operation returns one byte short with a nonnegative completion; no Plan ready state or H2D may publish
faults.eio: first graph-demanded source operation returns deterministic EIO; no Plan ready state or H2D may publish
faults.out_of_order: the first two matching-window source tickets complete in reverse submission order; all outputs, logits, routes, and final state must remain control-exact
faults.stale_completion: after a window is recycled and reassigned, its earlier Plan window generation completes late; it must reject before H2D
faults.wrong_object: a completion carries a different demanded object identity; it must reject before H2D
faults.held_consumer: window recycle is attempted with a live real graph consumer; it must reject, then succeed through ordinary release and remain control-exact
faults.reset_outstanding: reset is attempted while the first demanded source read is outstanding; it must reject without advancing the epoch, then remain control-exact
faults.shutdown_live_consumer: shutdown is attempted while a real graph consumer is live; it must reject, then remain control-exact and close ordinarily
faults.partial_bundle: the first of three demanded tensor extents completes and the next extent fails; the bundle must never publish ready or start H2D

interpretation_rule: A fatal cell passes only with the declared rejection, zero accepted tokens/logits, zero H2D publication, one explicitly accounted Plan fault window, and a fully drained source executor. A recoverable cell passes only with the declared rejection or ordering, control-exact tokens/logits/routes/state, clean resources, and complete lifecycle closure. Preserve any valid negative; do not alter hooks or order after observing claim cells.
repetition_rule: One deterministic cell per declared mode. No outcome-selected repetition; a system-fault rerun requires documented repair, exact host preflight, and a new identity.
success_condition: All ten Qwen cells are evidence-valid under the declared outcomes. Cross-adapter wording additionally requires the four representative Gemma cells; Qwen-only success supports only tested fail-closed behavior in the Qwen adapter.
next_decision: If all Qwen cells pass, execute no-fault, short, stale, and held-consumer representatives through the real Gemma adapter before publication wording. Qwen3.6 MTP and the full Gemma performance population remain separate deferred campaigns.
